{{External|rsc=Bronze Plate Mail Body|rs|dw=Bronze Platebody}} {{Infobox Item |name = Bronze platebody |image = [[File:Bronze platebody.png]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Drop |examine = Provides excellent protection. |value = 160 |weight = 9.979 |exchange = Yes |id = 1117 }} [[File:Bronze platebody detail.png|150px|left]] The '''bronze platebody''' is an armour used in [[melee]] and the weakest of all [[Platebody|platebodies]]. It has no [[Defence]] requirement to equip and provides greater protection than a [[bronze chainbody]]. Like all platebodies, however, it gives a crippling negative bonus to the user's [[Ranged]] and [[Magic]] stats. Players with level 18 [[Smithing]] can make one by using 5 [[bronze bar]]s on an [[anvil]] while carrying a [[hammer]], granting 62.5 [[experience]]. Alternatively, they can be bought from [[Horvik's Smithy]] or [[Zenesha's Plate Mail Body Shop]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -30 |arange = -15 |dstab = +15 |dslash = +14 |dcrush = +9 |dmagic = -6 |drange = +14 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = body |image = [[File:Bronze platebody equipped male.png|170px]] |altimage = [[File:Bronze platebody equipped female.png|170px]] }} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Smithing |skill1lvl = 18 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 62.5 |members = No |ticks = 5 |tools = Hammer |facilities = Anvil |mat1 = Bronze bar |mat1quantity = 5 |output1 = Bronze platebody }} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Bronze platebody}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Bronze platebody}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 21 April 2021 |update = Fishing Trawler Improvements and Equipment Rebalance: Part One |change = The platebody's ranged attack bonus has been decreased from -10 to -15. }} {{Subject changes |date = 7 March 2005 |update = Mountain Daughter and Changes |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Bronze platebody detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Bronze platebody detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Bronze platebody (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Bronze platebody.png|center]] |- |29 March 2004 ⁠–
